note: LA.4 (programme A11.7), Spring Kafka. The producer sends to a same-class `private static final String TOPIC`; the consumer listens on `@KafkaListener(topics = Topics.ORDERS)`, a constant declared in ANOTHER class of its repo. Baseline 2026-09-18 (HEAD 7a4883b): both sides read as queue_*:unresolved:kafka, so the flow is invisible.
